# Accepted differences for the pure-move check (.github/workflows/pure-move.yml).
# One `path::qualified.name  reason` per line; see scripts/dev/check_move.py.
# The check reads this file from the PR's base branch, so an entry must land
# before the PR that needs it.  An entry excuses every change in its def, not
# only the moved import; the report labels each allowed def
# [imports/strings only] or [differs beyond imports and strings].
#
# Entries live for one stack of move PRs: the last PR of the stack empties this
# file again, so master never carries an exemption for a def that later edits
# could hide behind.

# (no entries: the #1660 M1-M3 stack that needed them is complete)
